newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends higher on CBOT spillover.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends higher on CBOT spillover.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled higher on spillover strength from the rally in CBOT grains and oilseeds, traders said.
CBOT corn futures surged on fund buying and on USDA cattle-on-feed data, and soybeans rallied on surprisingly high USDA weekly export inspections.
U.S. wheat markets were buoyed after Pakistan opted to buy 450,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, traders said.
MGE spring wheat settled three to six cents per bushel higher, with March up six cents at $3.90-3/4. May gained 4-3/4 cents TO $3.72.

The close in Minneapolis represented a contrast to KCBT and CBOT wheat, where the May contract outpaced nearby March. Traders said stocks were tight enough to warrant strength in the front month, and some sources speculated that the spread would widen further ahead of first-notice date.
Traders said volumes were moderate, and the MGE estimated Tuesday's spring wheat volume at 21.7 million bushels, down from 23.8 million Friday.
MGE barley closed unchanged to 10 cents per cwt higher, with March unchanged at $6.55.
